statement: How does internal developer AI usage translate into workforce output and productivity?

Disclosed AI code share is rising fast (Google >25% in 2024 to 75% in 2026; Zeta 89.6%; Compass 50-60%), but almost no company ties it to end-to-end delivery output; the bottleneck shifts to review and verification.
CODE GENERATION SHARE (Google): AI-generated share of new code rose from >25% (Oct 2024) to 50% (fall 2025) to 75% (Apr 2026), per the CEO.

PULL REQUEST & TASK THROUGHPUT (Microsoft/GitHub): Observational study of 16,223 Microsoft engineers (2025) found 40.5% more PRs in highest- vs zero-usage weeks; a 2022 RCT of 95 recruited developers found one task completed 55.8% faster.
LARGE-SCALE SYSTEM MODERNIZATION (Amazon): Java 17 upgrades fell from ~50 developer-days to a few hours; Amazon estimates 4,500 developer-years saved and $260M in annualized efficiency gains.
AUTONOMOUS AGENT SHIPPING (Stripe, Shopify): Over 1,000 merged PRs/week at Stripe are completely Minion-produced; 1 in 8 merged PRs at Shopify is co-authored by its River agent.
KNOWLEDGE WORKER LEVERAGE (Klarna, customer service not engineering): AI assistant did the work of 700 FTEs in its first month (2024).
EXPANSION SET CODE SHARE: Zeta 89.6%, Compass 50-60%, N-able 47%, Cognizant >40% (AI-assisted), FactSet 27% (adopting teams only). Denominators differ.

DISCLOSURE REGISTER (49 companies, 2025-2026): verified AI code-share disclosures cluster at 50%-90% (Airbnb, DoorDash, HubSpot, Chime, MakeMyTrip, Workday, Pinterest); output metrics are per-engineer (Meta +30%, Uber 2x, Block +150% code changes, IBM +45%, monday.com +32%); only Grab and monday.com disclose time-to-market.
TELEMETRY GAP: Output-side disclosures are rare and none is an end-to-end delivery metric; the 5%-15% organisational gain is a working hypothesis, not a disclosed figure.
Pichai: "more than a quarter of all new code at Google is generated by AI" (Q3 2024); "75% of all new code ... up from 50% last fall" (Apr 2026).
Meta: +30% output per engineer since the start of 2025 and +80% for AI power users (CFO, Q4 2025 prepared remarks). No primary-source AI code-share figure.
Microsoft dose-response study (preprint, 16,223 engineers, Feb-Dec 2025): +40.5% PRs holding measured development effort constant.
Amazon upgraded more than 50% of production Java systems in under six months; developers shipped 79% of auto-generated code reviews without additional changes.
Stripe Minions: "Over a thousand pull requests merged each week at Stripe are completely minion-produced" (Feb 2026). InfoQ reports 1,300/week; not used.
Klarna cut resolution time from 11 min to under 2 min, handling 2.3M chats in month 1.

PRODUCTIVITY EVIDENCE: 16 verified output figures. Delivery (what ships): only Block/Square (>3x features), monday.com (-38% time to market), Grab (up to -30%). Most other evidence is activity per engineer (PRs, commits, code changes) or undefined "productivity".

COUNTER-EVIDENCE AND LIMITS: METR early-2025 RCT (19% more task time while developers estimated 20% less; METR's early-2026 follow-up estimates 18% less time but calls it very weak evidence), DORA 2024 (stability -7.2% / throughput -1.5% per 25% more AI adoption), DORA 2025 (throughput improves, instability still rises), Faros (no company-level gain), Stack Overflow 2025 (46% distrust AI accuracy), Replit agent incident. Klarna is a limit, not harm: same 2024-based "over 700" estimate, no drop in satisfaction, humans still offered.
